name: Matthew Connor
bio: Matt Connor serves as Treasurer and Chief Financial Officer of Hephzibah Delight Global Mission, overseeing financial stewardship, budgeting, financial reporting, and internal financial controls.

He brings more than 20 years of progressive experience in corporate finance, accounting, treasury management, financial reporting, and organizational controllership. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Oakland University and has held a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential in Michigan.

Throughout his career, Matt has held senior financial leadership positions, including Vice President/Controller and Corporate Controller, supporting complex organizations, financial operations, and strategic decision-making.
He is committed to promoting financial transparency, accountability, and responsible stewardship of resources entrusted to the organization.
